canonical_selection_rule: Every filename in this directory is unique and was captured exactly once against the final implementation checkpoint. There is no competing/superseded evidence set within this directory, so every file listed below is CANONICAL. If a future audit adds a competing capture for an existing conceptual slot, the fail-closed rule is: the file with the latest capture timestamp recorded here wins (CANONICAL); the older file is re-marked SUPERSEDED. An unresolvable timestamp collision is AMBIGUOUS and blocks the slot from being treated as evidence until a human adjudicates it.
filename_collision_note: During capture, two filenames (01-...-nominal-populated.png, 04-...-rebuilding-populated.png) were found to collide with the pre-existing evidence verifier's broad *nominal*.png and *rebuild*.png glob patterns (unrelated Stage 2-3/4-5 slots), flipping PRESENT from 23 to 21 and AMBIGUOUS from 0 to 2.
